strengths: Correctly identifies GABAergic inhibitory lineage via GAD2 and coherent LAMP5/NXPH2/KIT/SV2C signature.
Correctly notes absence of PVALB/SST/VIP canonical markers.
weaknesses: Stops at broader GABAergic interneuron level despite direct LAMP5/ADARB2/TACR1 markers supporting a more specific lamp5 subtype.

strengths: Correct broad GABAergic identity; top2 candidate correctly includes lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron.
weaknesses: Top1 is an ancestor of the supported lamp5 subtype; final specificity is lower than original markers allow.

strengths: Most specific ontology-valid subtype with direct marker support (LAMP5, GAD2, ADARB2, TACR1, MDGA1, HAPLN1, NXPH2).
Aligns with DLPFC origin and coherent interneuron enrichment (GABA-ergic synapse, GABA synthesis).
weaknesses: Raw label includes unsupported 'VIP/NPY' speculation because VIP/NPY are not observed in the marker list.

supporting: GAD2 with GABA-ergic synapse/GABA synthesis enrichment establishes GABAergic identity.
LAMP5, KIT, SV2C, NXPH2, ADARB2, TOX2, SPHKAP, ANO1, HCRTR2, TACR1 directly support the lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron subtype.
PMID 39499736 supports cortical interneuron marker interpretation.
conflicting: No dominant conflicting lineage; weak basement-membrane/transport genes (COL4A4, SLC35F4, SLC27A6) are minor and do not outweigh the interneuron program.
enrichment_or_literature: GABA-ergic synapse; GABA synthesis, release, reuptake and degradation; Transmission across Chemical Synapses; Neuronal System.

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
